voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Over the Andes, nineteen forty-seven. The airliner Star Dust sent its last message in Morse code. It ended in a word that has never been explained.
S. T. E. N. D. E. C. The operator in Santiago asked again. The same word came back, twice more.
Star Dust never arrived. In nineteen ninety-eight, climbers found its wreckage high on Mount Tupungato.
The crash is broadly understood: in thick cloud, the crew descended too soon. No one aboard survived.
The word is not. A scrambled 'descent'? A misheard Morse sign-off? Only theories, never confirmed.
